query:
SELECT r.key, r.template_key,
                      COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT g.capability_id FROM org_role_grants g
                                      WHERE g.org_role_id = r.id), '{}') AS "grants!: Vec<i16>"
                 FROM org_roles r
                WHERE r.org_id = $1 AND r.is_system AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
